purpose: Carry protected embers/fire source from camp to signal frame during the finale.

gripZones.purpose: main carry grip; usable by either hand

logicalStates.shapeCue: flat dark bed; no raised spark/flame cue
raised ember forms plus sparse spark cue
small protected flame shape plus shield cue
logicalStates.runtimeCueIntent: small flame/smoke VFX; do not obscure handle

interactionIntent.carryMode: single primary grip; optional second-hand stabilization may be added without changing logical state
interactionIntent.dropBehavior: fail-forward/recoverable product intent; exact runtime recovery belongs to Claude
interactionIntent.stateAuthority: replicate/save logical state enum; do not network raw particles

readability: State must be readable by shape/VFX as well as color/emission.
Primary handle must remain visible and unobstructed in all states.
Silhouette should read as protected ember carrier at 2-3 m on Quest 2.
runtimeConstraints: Use simple primitive/convex colliders; source mesh is not a collider prescription.
No dynamic cloth or simulated loose fuel required.
Keep flame/ember VFX bounded inside guard silhouette.
Unity material/shader/emission tuning is Claude-owned and must be device-tested.
acceptanceForSource: OBJ parses with non-degenerate faces and metre-scale bounds.
Primary grip geometry exists as named object group.
SVG documents cold/ember/lit states with non-color-only cues.
Contract names source files, grip, state semantics and runtime ownership.
